paragraphs.text: Dear Hiring Manager, I am writing to apply for the Backend Engineer — Distributed Systems position. My background as a Développeuse backend at Atelier Numérique, including work with Go and Kubernetes, aligns with your platform group's focus on designing, building, and operating services. I share your emphasis on pragmatic engineering and measurable impact, and I am eager to contribute to your Go-based APIs and platform reliability.

My technical foundation includes Go and Kubernetes, including work on migrating services to Kubernetes at Atelier Numérique. This directly supports your requirement for engineers comfortable running services in production and improving observability, latency, and reliability. I also value clear written communication when explaining design trade-offs or reviewing work with teammates.

At Atelier Numérique, I contributed to an improvement in API response times of 35 % during 2021–2023. That measurable improvement in latency reflects the results-oriented engineering your team values, and I am ready to bring that same focus to your distributed systems platform. Thank you for your consideration. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my background can support your team.
